verdict.rationale: Spline documents self-hosted export (full project, assets, and runtime as a self-contained ZIP) and code export in multiple open web formats (Vanilla JS, Three.js, React, Next.js, react-three-fiber), giving users a way to take their scene data out of the platform entirely rather than being locked into a proprietary cloud-only format. Missing for 10: no evidence of exporting to standard interchange 3D formats (e.g., glTF/OBJ), no independent/hands-on confirmation that self-hosted exports are truly complete and portable, and no mention of exporting non-visual metadata (variables, version history) alongside the scene.
